info.title: YieldVault Stellar RWA API
info.description:
API documentation for the YieldVault Stellar RWA backend. The API exposes vault deposits/withdrawals, portfolio reads, referrals, webhooks, and operational admin endpoints. Errors use the standard envelope `{ error, status, code, message, retryable, correlationId }`.

**Rate limiting:** Global limiter is 100 requests / 15 minutes per IP; authenticated API endpoints are limited to 30 requests / minute per API key. Exceeding a limit returns `429` with the standard error envelope and a `retryAfter` detail.

bearerAuth.description: JWT issued by POST /auth/login or POST /auth/refresh. `exp` is enforced with **zero** clock tolerance — a token is rejected the moment it expires. Only `nbf`/`iat` get a 5s tolerance for clock skew. The revocation list is checked on every authenticated request, so a token presented after `POST /auth/logout` (401 `TOKEN_REVOKED`) or after `POST /auth/logout-all` is refused immediately rather than at expiry.

idempotencyKey.name: x-idempotency-key
idempotencyKey.description: Recommended for mutation requests to ensure idempotency.

correlationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
correlationId.description: Optional client-supplied correlation id. If omitted, the server generates one and echoes it back in the response header for distributed tracing.

pageSize.name: limit
pageSize.description: Maximum number of items to return. Hard ceiling is 50 (default 20). A larger value is **rejected**, not clamped, with `400` and `code: "LIMIT_EXCEEDED"` — the response body repeats the ceiling so clients can self-correct. Use `page` (clamped to 1..1000) to walk the rest.

pageNumber.name: page
pageNumber.description: 1-based page number for offset pagination. Values outside 1..1000 are clamped rather than rejected, and the effective page is echoed back in `pagination.currentPage`.

message.example: Some of the information you provided is invalid. Please check and try again.

get.description: Paginated listing of active (non-deleted) vaults. `limit` is capped at 50 and `page` at 1000; exceeding `limit` fails fast with `400` / `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` instead of silently clamping, so a client that asks for an oversized page is never handed a response that looks complete. Rate limited: global 100 req / 15 min per IP; authenticated APIs 30 req / min per key. `429` responses follow the standard error envelope with a `retryAfter` detail.
Returns immediately with service health status and dependency checks.

503.description: One or more dependencies are down

get.description: Returns 200 only when all critical dependencies are available.
Exposes Prometheus-scraped metrics (request counts, latency, vault TVL).

post.description: Issues a 15-min access JWT + 7-day refresh token. Rate limited: global 100 req / 15 min per IP; authenticated APIs 30 req / min per key. `429` responses follow the standard error envelope with a `retryAfter` detail.
Issues a new access JWT; reuse of a revoked refresh token is rejected (401).

get.description: Returns TVL, share price, and APY summary for the vault.

Returns the annualised APY for the specified vault. Returns `apy: null` with `apyStatus: 'insufficient_data'` when the vault has zero shares or fewer than two price snapshots (e.g. a newly created vault).

apy.description: Annualised APY as a decimal percentage. null when insufficient data.

post.description: Creates a deposit. Requires allowlisted wallet. Rate limited: global 100 req / 15 min per IP; authenticated APIs 30 req / min per key. `429` responses follow the standard error envelope with a `retryAfter` detail.

Creates a withdrawal of claimable balance. Rate limited: global 100 req / 15 min per IP; authenticated APIs 30 req / min per key. `429` responses follow the standard error envelope with a `retryAfter` detail.

get.description: Returns the currently selected vault strategy.
Paginated transaction history. Supports cursor + page pagination.
